svg.title: wd2l state of health dashboard (mockup)
svg.desc: Mockup with illustrative values. Enclave 2 SIEM dashboard for wd2l during a fiber or optic fault (rule 7) at 13:41Z, after a clean planned stop that morning. Top row: transfer status RED, fault in the boundary segment, 37 events lost with capture NIC receive errors; receiver last heard 12 s ago; 37 open gap events; 1 of 2 streams balanced; time OK; audit trail OK. Then the six-segment pipeline with the boundary red, charts of events in versus delivered, delay by segment, clock skew and gaps by reason, the reconciliation and fault history tables, one detail table per segment, and the audit events to review. Panel numbers match the panel table in docs/state-of-health.md.
